titulo: Cheer up, you can do it!
intro: Calming someone down, comforting them, encouraging them and offering your help.
p.calmarse.consejo: It is pronominal. The command is «cálmate», with an accent, because the stress falls on the first syllable.
p.relajarse.consejo: The j sounds like h. The command is «relájate», with an accent, and it is the form you hear most.
p.consolar.consejo: The o becomes «ue»: «consuelo», «consuelas». The noun «consuelo» comes from it.
p.no te pongas así.consejo: It is a negative command: «pongas» is in the subjunctive. With «usted»: «no se ponga así».
p.todo saldrá bien.consejo: «Saldrá» is the future of «salir» and has an accent on the a. It is a very common phrase for comforting.
p.todo tiene solución.glosa: there is a solution for everything
p.todo tiene solución.consejo: It is a very common phrase of encouragement. «Solución» ends in -ción and has an accent.
p.arreglarse.consejo: With «se» the problem solves itself: «todo se arreglará». Without «se», «arreglar» is to fix something.
p.ánimo.consejo: It has an accent on the á. It is used to cheer someone on: «¡ánimo!». It also means «mood».
p.rendirse.consejo: The e becomes «i»: «me rindo», «no te rindas». It is used to say «do not quit».
p.tú puedes.consejo: «Tú» has an accent because it is a pronoun. «Puedes» comes from «poder», where the o becomes «ue».
p.conseguir.consejo: The e becomes «i»: «consigo», «consigues». «Lo conseguirás» means «you will manage it».
p.deja que te ayude.consejo: After «deja que» comes the subjunctive: «ayude». The y sounds as in «yo».
p.seguir intentándolo.consejo: The gerund and «lo» join: «intentándolo», with an accent. «Seguir» changes e to i: «sigue».
p.temer.consejo: It is more literary than «tener miedo»: «no hay nada que temer». It ends in r: the stress is at the end.
b1.texto:
**Calming.** Reflexive commands: **Cálmate.** **Relájate.** Or just the adjective: **Tranquilo, hombre.** **Tranquila, mujer.** Here **hombre** and **mujer** add warmth, nothing else.

Negative commands, with the subjunctive: **No te preocupes.** **No te pongas así.**

**Comforting.** With the future and **seguro que**:

- **Ya ha pasado.**
- **Seguro que no es nada.**
- **Todo saldrá bien.**
- **Todo tiene solución.**

**Encouraging.**

- **¡Ánimo!** **¡Venga!** **¡Vamos!**
- **No hay nada que temer.**
- **Sigue intentándolo.** **No te rindas.**
- **Tú puedes.** **Lo conseguirás.**

**Offering help.** You already knew **¿Quieres que te ayude?** Now also:

- **Deja que te ayude.**
- **Déjame a mí.** (when you take over)
b2.f0.texto: I am going to fail the exam again.
b2.f1.texto: Do not get like that, dear.
b2.f2.texto: I stalled the car three times last time.
b2.f3.texto: You have practised a lot and you drive very well.
b2.f4.texto: And what if I fail again?
b2.f5.texto: Keep trying and do not give up.
b2.f6.texto: Do you really think everything will turn out fine?
b2.f7.texto: Let me take you to the exam.
b4.texto:
To calm and encourage you mostly use commands:

- Affirmative reflexive: **cálmate**, **relájate**, **anímate**.
- Negative, with the subjunctive: **no te preocupes**, **no te rindas**, **no te pongas así**.
- Future for comforting: **todo saldrá bien**, **lo conseguirás**.
- **Seguro que** + indicative: **seguro que todo se arregla**.
- **Deja que** + subjunctive: **deja que te ayude**.
b4.e1.texto: I am sure that everything will sort itself out.
b5.f0.texto: Inés waits, seated on a cold bench, in front of the traffic office.
b5.f1.texto: Her hands sweat on her knees.
b5.f2.texto: A white car appears at the end of the street with a slow hum.
b5.f3.texto: Rafael watches her from afar and raises his thumb with an enormous smile.
b5.f4.texto: She closes her eyes and slowly counts to ten.
b5.f5.texto: Inside the car, the steering wheel looks enormous under her fingers.
b5.f6.texto: The examiner writes something in his notebook without looking up.
b5.f7.texto: Inés remembers Rafael's words and lets out her breath little by little.
b5.f8.texto: The car turns along a wide street and climbs towards a square full of sun.
b5.f9.texto: In the end, the examiner smiles and holds out his hand to her.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: the negative command takes the subjunctive.
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is indicative; a negative command asks for the subjunctive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive does not work for a negative command with «te».
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it sounds friendly; it means nothing more.
b7.o1.refuerzo: It does not insult: it is a touch of affection.
b7.o2.refuerzo: You can say it to a woman too: «tranquila, hombre».
b8.o0.refuerzo: It is indicative; after «deja que» comes the subjunctive.
b8.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «deja que» asks for the present subjunctive.
b9.traduccion: Do not be afraid to ask
b10.o0.refuerzo: It sounds like a hopeless end: it does not comfort.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Yes: it promises there is a way out.
b10.o2.refuerzo: It says the opposite: that it cannot be fixed.
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «You can do it.» (tú)
b12.o0.refuerzo: It asks for calm, not for you to keep trying.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It comforts because something ended; it does not urge you on.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Yes: «rendirse» is quitting, and «no te rindas» prevents it.
b12.pregunta: Which sentence urges you not to quit?
p.calé.consejo: In driving, «calar» means the engine stops by mistake.
p.practicado.consejo: With «has», it forms the perfect: «has practicado», you have practised.
p.conduces.consejo: «conducir» means to drive. Note the c sounds like th.
p.rindas.consejo: «rendirse» means to give up. Here it is a request with «no».
p.cálmate.consejo: «cálmate» is a command. The pronoun «te» is attached to it.
p.arreglará.consejo: Future of «arreglar», to fix or sort out.
p.sentada.consejo: From «sentarse». The feminine form matches Inés.
p.sudan.consejo: From «sudor», sweat. The verb «sudar» is used for nervous hands too.
p.levantar.consejo: «sin levantar la vista» means without looking up.
p.suelta.consejo: «soltar el aire» means to let air out, to breathe out.
p.tiende.consejo: «tender la mano» means to offer your hand to shake or help.
p.calidez.consejo: From «cálido», warm. It describes kindness and comfort.
p.ayude.consejo: After «que» expressing hope, use the subjunctive: «que ayude».
p.preguntar.consejo: «tener miedo de» plus infinitive means to be afraid of doing something.
